title: Ordinary lift of one specified diagonal orientation
statement: In the finite setting [def-pur-conventions], let f:X→Y be separated, finite type and smooth of pure relative dimension d, with compactification and finite-type structure map aY to Spec k. For one affine target open V and one Chart D of [lem-pur-diagonal-orientation-refinement], the local four-factor isomorphism theta_D has an ordinary-etale lift between the exact restrictions of the ordinary dualizing object and A_X(d)[2d] of [def-pur-diagonal-dualizing-data]. The realization uses the specified unit conversion and the natural exact restriction/site-comparison isomorphism, and its realization is exactly theta_D. No family, compatibility, global orientation or normalization theorem is assumed.

proof.text: Tensor induction on d identifies the ordered coefficient object with the finite Tate sheaf A(d) shifted by 2d. Flatness of each finite Tate line makes the derived tensor of its single complex the single of its tensor. Undo the shift to prove concentration in degree zero.

Conjugate theta by the unit conversion and the exact restriction/site comparison. This is an isomorphism nu*M≈nu*N. Exact restriction preserves concentration of the shifted Tate target; exact comparison preserves and reflects concentration. Hence the shifted source is concentrated too, so M and N are bounded below.

Apply the existing bounded-below comparison Hom bijection to the isomorphism and its inverse. Injectivity gives their inverse equations. Cancel the conjugating comparisons to obtain the specified realization.

theorem chart_lift (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [HasCompactification f]
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f] (V : Y.affineOpens)
    (D : OrientationRefinement.Chart P f aY d V) :
    ∃ b : (restrict P (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι).obj (P.diagonalOrdinaryDualizing f) ≅
      (restrict P (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι).obj (P.diagonalTwistEtale X d),
      realize P f aY d V b =
        OrientationRefinement.theta P f aY d V D.geometry D.betaEtale
